title: Materials.
officialText:
Structural steel piles, steel pipe and fully welded steel piles fabricated from plates shall conform to ASTM
A 36, ASTM A 252, ASTM A 283, ASTM A 572, ASTM A 588, ASTM A 690, ASTM A 913 or ASTM A 992.
